testcase.name: version-skew/kube-proxy-post-upgrade

failure.message: kube-proxy would exceed version skew after upgrading to 1.35

testcase.failure: kube-proxy would exceed version skew after upgrading to 1.35. After upgrading the control plane to 1.35, kube-proxy 1.20, 1.29 would be more than 3 minor versions behind kube-apiserver; upgrade kube-proxy first. kube-proxy versions older than 1.25 may be at most 2 minor versions behind. References: - https://kubernetes.io/releases/version-skew-policy/

testcase.name: version-skew/kube-proxy-behind
testcase.system-out: warning: kube-proxy exceeds version skew vs kube-apiserver. kube-proxy 1.20, 1.29 is more than 3 minor version(s) behind the newest kube-apiserver (1.34). kube-proxy versions older than 1.25 may be at most 2 minor versions behind. References: - https://kubernetes.io/releases/version-skew-policy/

testcase.name: version-skew/kube-proxy-kubelet/node-b
testcase.system-out: warning: kube-proxy on node node-b exceeds version skew vs its kubelet. kube-proxy v1.29.0 on node node-b is more than 3 minor version(s) older or newer than the kubelet on that node (v1.33.1). References: - https://kubernetes.io/releases/version-skew-policy/#kube-proxy
